title: Paperclip scientists split between Redstone Arsenal and Los Alamos, linked to contact events

plain: Matthew Brown, described as a former Pentagon insider, tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, how the German scientists brought to America after 1945 were divided up. He says those who were Nazis in name only settled around Redstone Arsenal, an Army base in Huntsville, Alabama, while the true believers went to Los Alamos, the weapons laboratory in New Mexico. Brown links this split to later contact with non-human beings, which would mean committed Nazis were close to the most secret work.
